recommendedBy: session agent, working one component at a time

items.why: A silent unstyled render is a bad failure mode for a design system, and one app shipped that way unnoticed.
A minimap that mounts before its content draws nothing, ever, and the fix is a judgement about how far to reach.
Its placeholder bullet needs an owner decision: repaint every placeholder, or document the colour that ships.
Card documents a containing block it does not establish, so a consumer positioning inside it lands on the page.
A responsive header the stylesheet has no media query for.
A section the gate has never once photographed.
Four drifts in one specification, including a selector it invites consumers to trust.
